best_description:
Trigger when a user wants to preserve a hard-won technical insight so future sessions don't rediscover it. Key signal: they just described something surprising and want it recorded â€” even if they don't use documentation verbs. "Capture this before we forget", "lets not lose this", "before we move on", and similar memory-preservation phrases are strong triggers, as are "distill", "write it up", "document this", "worth noting for next time". The user's intent is retention across sessions, not explanation or task completion.

Skip for: fixing bugs, adding features, reading existing solutions (/brief), writing inline code comments, updating README or TODO files.
